title: .to_string() on &'static str keys in ws/mod.rs send_request
description: ws/mod.rs lines 99 and 101 (production send_request): obj.insert("@type".to_string(), ...) and obj.insert("id".to_string(), ...). String literals are &'static str; .to_string() allocates. Idiomatic alternatives: "@type".to_owned() (clippy::str_to_string), or use serde_json::json\! macro to build the insertion. Also line 181: "invalid auth header value".to_string() in connect_ws error path — same pattern, prefer .to_owned() or .into().
